property_summary: After calling NETM() as a non-owner (user), in reference P the require in onlyOwner fails (owner != msg.sender is false) so the function reverts and balances of user stays 0; in bug M the require passes (owner != msg.sender is true) so the function executes, setting balances[user] = totalDistributed (250000000e18).
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow only non-owner addresses, so that only non-owner can call owner-only functions.
